# DzTree

Hierarchical tree view with expand/collapse, selection, and checkboxes.

- **Family:** Data display
- **Source:** `packages/core/src/components/data/DzTree.vue` · types `packages/core/src/components/data/DzTree.types.ts`
- **Install:** `npm i @dzup-ui/core` — then `import { DzTree } from '@dzup-ui/core'`
- **Entry points:** `@dzup-ui/core`, `@dzup-ui/core/data`
- **Risk tier:** C · **Status:** stable
- **Taxonomy:** size: `icon` `xs` `sm` `md` `lg` `xl`
- **v-model:** `v-model:activeKey` (`string | undefined`), `v-model:expandedKeys` (`string[] | undefined`), `v-model:selectedKeys` (`string[] | undefined`)

| `nodeExpand` | `[node: TreeNode<unknown>]` | Emitted when a node is expanded |
